f.title: Maintain compliance management procedures and processes
f.statement: For compliance management, MAHs shall have quality system procedures and processes ensuring continuous monitoring of PV data, examination of risk minimisation and prevention options and appropriate measures, and the scientific evaluation of all information on the risks of medicinal products, including adverse reactions from use within or outside the MA terms or from occupational exposure.
